_readme: HOW TO ADD PHOTOS: 1) copy your JPG/PNG/WebP photos into this folder (assets/gallery/). 2) add an entry to 'slides' below: {"src":"my-photo.jpg","title":"Kitchen slider","caption":"Milgard V300 black/black, Scottsdale"}. 3) delete the placeholder-*.svg entries. Tip: resize photos to ~1600px wide so they load fast. Reload the app (online once) so it caches them for offline use.
